C1118.title: Forcepoint X-Labs Discloses 10 Indirect Prompt Injection Payloads Found in the Wild
C1118.summary: On April 22, 2026, Forcepoint X-Labs published threat-hunting findings describing 10 verified indirect prompt injection payloads on active websites. The payloads were concealed in HTML comments, hidden elements, or metadata and pursued goals including API-key exfiltration, unauthorized transactions, data destruction, and denial of service. The report characterized them as observations in the wild rather than laboratory demonstrations.
